title: Çatalhöyük town
summary: Houses packed together without streets, entered through the roof, with murals and burials under floors. A mural often called the oldest map may instead show a leopard skin.
why: A dense Neolithic town with art inside its homes.

notes.problem: 'Oldest map' is disputed in the source (Meece: more likely a leopard skin).

superlativeSource: is frequently cited as the world's oldest map
